description: Explotaciones de regadío por procedencia del agua de riego is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Comunidad de Madrid. The agricultural holding shall: It can be defined as an agricultural unit (set of land and/or livestock), under a single management, located in a given geographical location and using the same means of production. Coverage: Comunidad de Madrid. The portal shows the English title as "Irrigation holdings by source of irrigation water" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Comunidad de Madrid. Its keywords include Censo agrario, Sector agrario. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2026-08-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
